findings.title: Command and its arguments are one string
findings.cause: container worker's command is the single string "sleep 3600", so the runtime looks for an executable named "sleep 3600", spaces included, and there is none; each argument has to be its own list item; Deployment worker has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: failed to create containerd task: failed to create shim task: OCI runtime create failed: runc create failed: unable to start container process: error during container init: exec: "sleep 3600": executable file not found in $PATH

evidence.what: container worker's command is "sleep 3600", one string

findings.fix: Write the command as a list with one item per word: ["sleep", "3600"] instead of ["sleep 3600"].
